name: canvas
description: Canvas LMS through a renewed browser session: courses, grades, submission state, announcements and inbox headers, with tap-approved writes and courses you can lock to metadata only.

setup.prompt: The tailnet address the private login page will be served at: this server's Tailscale name and a free port
Tailscale account(s) allowed to open the login page (the email you sign in to Tailscale with)
Course codes Herald may see only names, dates and grades for, never content or files (for a syllabus that bans AI tools on course materials). Empty for none
Where the session cookies and browser profile are kept (private, never committed)
Loopback port for the login page
Directories a submission may upload files from
Storage hosts Canvas may hand uploads to, besides Canvas itself

provides_capabilities.title: Canvas
provides_capabilities.summary: Courses, grades, submission state, announcements and inbox headers.
provides_capabilities.setup_hint: Start herald-canvas-login.service and open canvas.login_url on your phone to log in once.
